author: snackwallace
body:
Hello, as you can see under the infractions section this account was banned for what I am assuming association with the banned account J_ake (this is J_ake speaking by the way, on behalf of sibling) I have no intention of returning to the Avicus Network, however the case may be different for my smaller brother. We live in the same house, yes, we use the same internet, and we also play the same minecraft servers. I am not quite sure how to prove that this account is not actually mine, but feel free to ask me more questions about it.

ONCE AGAIN: This is J_ake (a banned user) writing up a BAN APPEAL for a FALSELY BANNED account. This account belongs to my little brother. Please unban.
